paper.title: Google Scholar Citation Analysis of Algorithmic Models in Vision Transformer Models Automated Crop Disease Detection Tomato Leaf Care Diagnosis
paper.abstract:
This Google Scholar publication by Prof. Robert Zhang, Elena Rostova presents an engineering framework targeting Vision transformer models for automated crop disease detection and tomato leaf care diagnosis. The work addresses critical bottlenecks in real-time execution, scalability under heavy load, and citation grounding accuracy across empirical datasets.

Through extensive experiments, the proposed model achieves benchmark improvements in decision precision, demonstrating strong robustness across diverse deployment environments.
